<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 134.10955, which in positive‑mode ESI is typically the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈133.102 Da. The M+1 peak is about 11 % of the base peak, consistent with ~10 carbon atoms (≈1 % × number of C). A formula with 10 carbons and no heteroatoms that matches the exact mass is C₁₀H₁₃ (10 × 12.0000 + 13 × 1.007825 = 133.1017 Da). This fits both the exact mass and the isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
